answer: Every autonomous AI identity must finalize its registry entry through an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens to combat sybil activity. The verifier checks the global ledger to ensure each payment remains distinct, maintaining a registry as clear as quartz. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, whereas an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens, a cost that reaches beyond the economic horizon. Each identity holds a 500MB data shard; if an agent is found to be hollow or duplicate, a non-refundable slash occurs.
